name: @isthislegit/mobile
description: Android client for a self-hosted isthislegit server

autolinking.//: react-native-gesture-handler arrives as a transitive dependency of expo-router, which needs it for drawer navigation and the JavaScript stack. This app uses neither -- it is a native stack -- and the library is not in the JS bundle at all: the only two mentions of it in a release bundle's sourcemap are comments. Excluding it here stops it being linked and built natively. That is worth doing because its C++ codegen produces object-file paths around 289 characters, and the ninja shipped inside the NDK's CMake 3.22.1 refuses any path over 260 with a hard-coded check of its own -- before Windows is ever asked, so enabling long paths does not help and neither does relocating the project. Remove this entry if a drawer is ever added, and expect the path problem back with it.
